study: unified-ml-pipelines v2: training-serving skew, reproducibility, and CI gating on public tabular data
registered_before: any full experiment run; only unit tests and small smoke runs on subsets are executed while developing the code
hypothesis: Serving features produced by a single shared feature definition (feature-store pattern with point-in-time correct aggregates) yield a higher online ROC AUC than a dual implementation (batch pandas for training, separate per-request Python for serving) that contains five documented divergence sources.
baseline: Dual implementation with all five divergence sources enabled: missing_default, precision, encoding_order, stale_window, pit_leakage.
treatment: Single feature definition used for offline backfill and online serving.
split: random arrival order per seed; first 70% of arrivals train, last 30% are replayed as serving requests

primary_endpoint.name: delta_auc_online
primary_endpoint.definition: AUC_online(single) - AUC_online(dual, all sources), paired by dataset and seed, on the 30% held-out serving requests
primary_endpoint.summary: per dataset: mean over 5 seeds with a two-sided 95% t confidence interval (df = 4)

decision_rule.SUPPORTED: in at least 2 of 3 datasets the mean delta_auc_online >= 0.005 and the 95% CI lower bound > 0
decision_rule.REFUTED: in at least 2 of 3 datasets the 95% CI upper bound < 0.005

falsification_rule: The hypothesis is refuted if, in at least 2 of 3 datasets, the 95% CI of delta_auc_online lies entirely below the minimum meaningful effect of 0.005 AUC.
secondary_endpoints: request-level skew rate (requests with any feature mismatch / requests), for each path and each single divergence source (ablation)
prediction disagreement rate at threshold 0.5 between offline and online feature vectors under the same model
offline-online AUC gap of each path
breakpoints: online-store timeout rates for the single path, 4x higher missingness, covariate-shifted arrival order
reproducibility: bit-identical model rate over reruns under pinned vs unpinned regimes, and the fraction of non-identical reruns whose lineage hash also changed (explicit vs resolved lineage)
simulated CI gate: injected regressions caught by an AUC-only gate vs an AUC+skew gate, and false blocks on benign changes
expectations_stated_in_advance: single-path skew rate is 0 without timeouts (by construction; a sanity check, not evidence for the hypothesis)
skew rate is expected to be a poor proxy for harm: precision rounding may produce many mismatches with little prediction change
analysis_constraints: No result-dependent changes to datasets, seeds, divergence parameters, or thresholds after the first full run. Any deviation is reported in REVIEW.md and the paper.
